name: Tenma Numahime
source:
One of the Dai Tenma and a pillar of Yatsukahagi.

Her existence is somewhat uncertain towards other people outside of Edo, because of her form is ever-changing, hence no one can fully grasp her true identity.

[spoiler]She is close to Momiji who can sit down and talk with, however in fact she's really unpredictable with abnormality beyond comprehension.

Due to this point, Numahime is a very dangerous opponent when it comes to unpredictability.[/spoiler]

"How shameful and envious i am. Even i forgot the violation that happened to me too."

[spoiler]In truth she is one of the female character in [url=https://vndb.org/v548#main]Dies Irae[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c28993]Rusalka Schwägerin[/url], after the death of [url=https://vndb.org/c29001]Marie[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c28998]Mercurius[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c22061]Reinhard Heydrich[/url], she along with other survived members of Marie universe joined in the group formed by [url=https://vndb.org/c22060]Ren[/url] in order to protect what's left of her world.[/spoiler]
